title: Corporate travel Consultant Amadeus Sabre
description:
Job Description We are looking for an experienced Travel Consultant After-Hours / Emergency Support to provide high-quality travel assistance and customer service across Business, Leisure, Retail, and Tours divisions. 
 The role will act as the primary point of contact for clients during non-standard business hours, managing travel-related inquiries, disruptions, emergency situations, and complex travel transactions while ensuring compliance with company policies and service standards. 
 Key Responsibilities Serve as the first point of contact for client interactions during after-hours and emergency situations. Provide timely and effective resolution to travel-related queries and issues while maintaining exceptional customer service. Handle travel transactions including bookings, ticketing, reissues, exchanges, and cancellations . Use Sabre, Amadeus, and internal travel systems to process travel transactions accurately. Interpret and apply fare rules, airline policies, ticketing regulations, and applicable travel requirements . Manage Irregular Operations (IROPs) , including airline schedule changes, cancellations, delays, and other travel disruptions. Handle urgent and high-pressure situations professionally while minimizing customer impact. Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions, call summaries, actions taken, and follow-ups. Support operational activities including queue management and quotation preparation . Coordinate with global Destination Management Companies (DMCs), travel suppliers, airlines, and internal stakeholders to meet client requirements. Ensure adherence to established SLAs, productivity targets, quality standards, and company procedures . Stay updated on airline policies, travel industry developments, regulations, and internal processes. 
 Qualifications & Experience Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in leisure travel, corporate travel, business travel, or after-hours/emergency travel support . Experience working in a travel call center / contact center environment will be preferred. Strong experience handling customers in time-sensitive and high-pressure situations. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Excellent communication skills are mandatory. 
 Mandatory Technical Skills Hands-on experience with both Amadeus and Sabre GDS is mandatory. Strong knowledge of airline ticketing, reissues, exchanges, cancellations, and fare rules . Knowledge of fare construction and BSP (Billing and Settlement Plan) processes. Experience handling Canadian and United States Point-of-Sale (POS) commissions. Strong understanding of airline policies and travel regulations. 
 Operational Expertise Proven experience handling IROPs and airline schedule changes . Working knowledge of corporate travel services , including: Air bookings Hotel bookings Car rentals Package bookings Ability to work according to client-specific travel policies and procedures . Experience managing urgent travel requests and emergency situations independently. 
 Core Competencies Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong customer service orientation. Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Sound decision-making and call-routing abilities. Excellent organizational and time-management skills. High attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Strong team collaboration skills. Flexible and comfortable working in rotational shifts . 
 What Were Looking For We are seeking travel professionals who are confident in handling after-hours travel emergencies, airline disruptions, complex ticketing, and customer escalations . If you have hands-on experience in both Amadeus and Sabre and are looking to build your career in a fast-paced global travel support environment, we would like to hear from you. 
 Interested candidates can share resume to syed.muzammil@sutherlandglobal.com or Whatsapp to 6361117171

title: Senior Manager - Transition & Migrations - Global Service Centre
description:
About DP World Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the worlds trade flow better, changing whats possible for the customers and communities we serve globally. With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 111,000 employees from 159 nationalities, spanning 77 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain thats fit for the future. We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses -- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades. What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door. 
 About DP World Global Service Centre DP World’s Global Service Centre (GSCs) are key enablers of growth delivering standardization, process excellence and expertise, and automation in areas of Finance, Freight Forwarding, Marine Services, Engineering and Human Resources, helping accelerate DP World’s growth and business transformation. As we experience exponential growth, there has never been a more exciting time to join us. Discover your next role here and change what's possible for everyone! As an equal employer that recognizes and values diversity and an inclusive culture, we empower and up-skill our people with opportunities to perform at their best. Join us and be part of an amazing team that is transforming the future of world trade. 
 Role Purpose Lead the end-to-end design and transition of work from regions into the GSC, shaping sustainable delivery solutions from target operating model, organization and team structure, capacity and skill requirements, governance and controls through knowledge transfer, readiness, go-live and stabilization. Independently partner with regional and functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical, scalable solutions and ensure controlled, transparent and successful transitions.
 
 Designation: Senior Manager - Transition & Migrations - Global Service Centre Department – Business Process Base Location: Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai Reporting To: Vice President 
 Key Role Responsibilities Collaborate independently with regional stakeholders and GSC functional owners to understand business objectives, process scope, pain points, volumes, service expectations, controls and dependencies. Design end-to-end GSC / offshoring solutions, including target operating model, team structure, spans and layers, capacity, skill mix, governance and charge back. Translate the agreed solution into detailed process scope, resource requirements, implementation approach, dependencies, assumptions, service levels, controls and measurable business outcomes. Apply strong knowledge of GSC, shared services and offshoring models, transition methodologies, process design, operational controls and industry best practices to develop practical and scalable solutions. Act as a trusted advisor and primary transition / solutioning partner to senior regional and functional stakeholders, independently leading discussions, workshops, negotiations and decision-making forums. Communicate solution options, trade-offs, risks, dependencies and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders; constructively challenge assumptions where required to protect transition and operational outcomes. Collaborate with GSC leadership, operations, process owners, HR, finance, technology, Process Excellence and other enabling functions to validate solution feasibility and ensure end-to-end implementation readiness. Define clear roles, responsibilities, decision rights and governance across regional and GSC teams throughout solution design, transition and stabilization. Prepare and maintain comprehensive solution and transition documentation, including scope and process maps, target operating model, organization design, resource and capacity plans, RACI, assumptions, dependencies, business case inputs, implementation plans and governance packs. Own end-to-end transitions of process scope from regions into the GSC, from initiation and due diligence through planning, knowledge transfer, readiness, go-live, stabilization and formal handover to operations. Define transition objectives, in-scope / out-of-scope activities, success measures, milestones, deliverables and acceptance criteria jointly with stakeholders and receiving operations teams. Develop and manage integrated transition plans covering resourcing, hiring and onboarding, knowledge transfer, training, access and technology readiness, controls, documentation, communications and operational readiness. Establish and govern structured transition toll gates with clear entry / exit criteria and evidence-based readiness assessments; ensure appropriate stakeholder sign-offs before progression and go-live. Maintain robust RAID management, proactively identifying risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies; define mitigants, owners and escalation paths and drive timely resolution of roadblocks. Lead transition governance and stakeholder reporting, tracking milestones, actions, decisions, readiness and overall transition health; escalate material risks or deviations with clear recommendations and recovery plans. Manage go-live and stabilization / hypercare, monitor agreed service and quality indicators, close residual risks and actions, capture lessons learned and complete a structured handover to business-as-usual operations. 
 Skills & Competencies Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, with significant hands-on experience in transition management, solutioning, shared services / GSC, BPO or offshoring environments. Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional transitions is essential. Strong knowledge of transition and solutioning frameworks, target operating model and organization design, capacity / resource planning, governance, toll-gate methodology, risk management, process migration and operational readiness. Strong analytical, structured problem-solving and commercial mindset, with the ability to convert ambiguous requirements into executable solutions and transition plans. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and influencing skills, with confidence engaging independently with senior leaders across regions and functions. Strong project and program management capability, including governance, milestone management, RAID management, executive reporting and management of multiple concurrent transitions. Demonstrated ownership, judgement and decision-making ability; comfortable challenging constructively, managing competing priorities and driving outcomes in a matrixed, multicultural environment. Strong change leadership and knowledge-transfer capability, with a focus on business continuity, control effectiveness, service quality and sustainable adoption. Ability to work autonomously, travel as required for transition activity, and manage stakeholders across geographies and time zones. 
 Education & Qualifications Minimum bachelor's degree in Business Management, Finance, Operations, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree and/or recognized project, transition or change management certification (e.g., PMP) is a plus. . DP World is committed to the principles of Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO). We strongly believe that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success and we make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or belief.

description:
To lead and manage the production operations across our three manufacturing units. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring operational efficiency, Production Targets, quality control, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery while aligning production activities with the companys strategic goals. Responsibilities 
Strategic Leadership & Planning:

Ensure compliance with all relevant industry standards, regulations, and internal quality policies.

Lead root cause analysis for quality issues and implement robust preventive measures.

Cost Management & Budgeting:

Manage production budgets effectively, identifying opportunities for cost reduction without compromising quality or safety.

Oversee resource utilization (materials, labor, machinery) to ensure optimal cost-effectiveness.

Negotiate with suppliers and manage vendor relationships to secure favorable terms for production inputs.

Timely Delivery & Supply Chain Coordination:

Collaborate closely with supply chain, procurement, and logistics teams to ensure the timely availability of raw materials and the efficient dispatch of finished goods.

Implement robust production scheduling to meet customer deadlines and reduce lead times.

Team Leadership & Development:

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of production managers, supervisors, and staff across all units.

Foster a positive and safe working environment, promoting employee engagement, training, and professional growth.

Ensure adherence to all safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

title: Head Beauty
description:
KEY TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES Responsible for monitoring the Administrative , Operational and Technical aspects & smooth functioning of the centre as a whole with emphasis on the Slimming and Beauty Sections in the Centres in order to ensure the optimum capacity utilization and quality service delivery to provide client delight: Documentation : Regular checking and corrective measures for filling of the Client Programme Records and other requisite documents & informing the Corporate Office. Ensure correct and timely software entries, checking them for necessary corrections. Monitoring Client Progress : Regular monitoring of progress of all clients. Organize periodic meetings with respective departments to resolve general and specific concerns. To interact with all clients (especially those losing slowly/not getting expected results ) personally and coordinate with R & D for further technical inputs, as and when required. Zero Sessions : Stringent Monitoring to ensure zero sessions are conducted as per SOP and within the stipulated timelines. Maintain liaison between the Centre and the Corporate Office. Knowledge transfer and technical inputs from R&D or Corporate Office to the respective Centre staff. To regularly update oneself on all Obesity / Beauty related research in ones region and share the relevant information pertaining to the same with R & D Dept. Communication, implementation and compliance of all Corporate policies in the Centre. Coordinate with Zonal head and Corporate Office in case of delays in the availability of stock - linen, documents, appliances and their accessories, and to ensure all equipment is in working condition at all times. To take Corporate guidance for booking of complicated Medical Cases. To take corrective measures, with advice from Corporate Office if required, in case of wrong bookings and medical contraindications. Executions & Compliance to SOP: To ensure that Centers achieve qualitative and quantitative executions as specified by the Corporate & according to the service delivery parameters given by R&D. To co-ordinate with R&D for any guidance regarding the same. Periodic technical audits and technical reviews of staff to check for compliance with SOP. Take corrective actions at Centre level and inform Corporate Office in case of deviations and refresher training required by the staff. Trainings : To identify the Training needs of the staff and inform the R & D of the following : - Training Needs -Fresher / Refresher / Advanced / Skill Gap Analysis / Other parameters requiring improvement on individual basis - To ensure stringent compliance of the Training Nomination SOP w.r.t Training Nomination Letter / Mandatory signing of Training Agreements by complete staff / Action on Non compliance - To ensure that the post Training Implementation feedback form is filled up for respective profiles as and when required and sent back to R & D - To ensure that the identified Centre staff ( Profilewise ) takes keen interest in the improvement of average performers and feedback of the same sent to the R & D Review the appointment planner: For optimum utilisation of infrastructure, staff and appliances. - To review and ensure that the Daily Monitoring Format is correctly and completely filled up and sent to the Corporate within the stipulated time line. Follow - up of irregular clients : Regular monitoring of client follow-up data wherever required and self follow-up for special clients including VIPs and Doctors. Unsuccessful but regular clients : Implementation of the specific technical inputs, including counseling of such clients and co-ordinate with Corporate Office for further technical inputs as and when required. To try and keep the percentage of USR clients within the minimum limit as specified by the Corporate. Validity Expiry : Monitoring of validities for calculations and informing the Corporate Office for any deviation and personal counseling of those clients who were regular but still could not complete the package. To try and expedite that the programme of maximum clients are completed within validity. Transfer/Conversion of Clients’ Progamme : Ensure that transfers/ conversions of the clients’ programme, if any, happen with the consent & coordination of client and the respective CH/AH. In case of inter centre transfers, to ensure transfer of client papers and credit note is done within 48 hours / before client approaches the concerned centre. Client complaints : Resolve escalated client issues and proactively initiate and reduce possible causes of complaints by customers. To ensure any client complaints is resolved within the next 7 days in case corporate intervention is required, else to resolve within the next 48 hours at the centre level itself. To ensure complete and fair compliance of the Customer Complaint SOP Staff : Recruitment and Induction: To ensure that the recruitments are done as per the specified SOP and to conduct the Induction of the new recruits as per designation wise Induction Schedules and to conduct induction sessions as specified for different profiles (Dietician / Slimming Head / Physiotherapist / Doctor / Beauty Head / Beauty Incharge / Hair Stylist / Pedicurist / Dermatologist) Induction : To assist in the recruitment of new Centre staff , conduct preliminary technical interviews of candidates in case of vacancy and forward for approval to Corporate Office. Orientation of Staff : To impart on-the-job training at Centre level, to new staff and send their periodic assessment to Corporate Office as specified in the SOP. Vacancies / TNA : Update the Corporate Office/Zonal Head periodically on the status for vacancies and training needs of the staff. Sales : Work with Sales team members & Slimming / Beauty In-charges to ensure meeting of in-house sales targets that may be set from time to time. To give realistic sales targets to individual staff members and monitor the same on a daily basis aiming towards the achievement of centre’s sales target. Events : To coordinate with the Corporate in giving technical support to the Centre for organizing the Events and sending feedback of the same to the Corporate. Two main events to be planned out and conducted every quarter, in co-ordination with the Corporate. Software entries: To ensure timely entries of data in the software and monitor the same. To send required data to IT department within the time line specified by the Corporate. On the basis of feedback given by the Corporate, actions to be immediately implemented and revertal on same given to the Corporate. Staff Attrition: To ensure that the staff attrition does not overshoot a maximum limit as specified by the Corporate. To ensure that all relevant contracts are in place for all staff members. To ensure optimum staff strength at the Centre at all times keeping in mind the influx and lean hours KEY ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES Sop’s: To ensure adherence & compliance to standard operating procedures at all times and to also ensure that standards are driven by the Center Manager(s) while providing ownership value. To oversee achievement of budgeted sales target every month & offer timely advice to team to review strategies to close sales & generate bookings more effectively and scientifically. Events : To review in consultation with Zonal head & Corporate approval – events / promotions planned, local ads to be released and unique packages formulated to match variety of budgets, in order to create & drive awareness about VLCC as a slimming, beauty & fitness ( Wellness ) brand. To ensure that the data on Centre level Marketing initiative / feedback is collated and analyzed and the same sent to the Head Marketing, Corporate and Regional VP Operations To promote WOL, family card or any other promotional programs / schemes that the corporate might launch from time to time . To monitor SMS data / Call Centre escalated queries / Alive Chat mails or any other marketing activities promoted by the marketing department at the corporate. To oversee monthly budget of the centre & team operations to bring down non-essential overhead costs without impacting quality of service. To monitor the effectiveness of yield/capacities in the centers and systems to ensure revenues are maximized and provide feedback to senior management To oversee duty roster & identify staff capable of multitasking and sending them for respective trainings for upgradation. Monthly/Dailly staff meetings : To help settle personnel grievances through a rational & open meeting or use personal discretion to intervene directly. To ensure that they are held on a monthly basis and to send the reports to the Corporate within the defined time line. To provide ongoing information and status reports to Regional Operations Head / Senior management team in the corporate on monthly basis on financial and operational performance of center(s). To oversee management & maintenance of all client records, attendance record, MIS reports, security arrangements, inventory control, compliance to all statutory obligations such as PF, ESIC, Bonus etc.. Checklists : To inspect the center by taking rounds and ensure that the upkeep is as per standard norms and the hygiene and sanitation conditions are par excellence. In addition ensure that machines are in working order. To fill the checklists on a monthly basis and forward the same to the Corporate within the stipulated time line. To explain the details of incentive plan / salary break up and regularly coordinate with HR on timely distribution of salaries and incentives to the center staff. To put forth recommendations to corporate office for centre renovation, relocation/ termination of manpower, and closure of certain sections of centre & discontinuing use of certain machines To conduct regular checks at the center to ensure consumption of products as per SOP and services executed at the centers and FIFO policy is being adhered to for product consumption / retail chain. To constantly upgrade oneself so as to achieve the progression level as per the multitasking / up gradation planner Additional Responsibilities: 1. To offer assistance in pre opening activities of new centers by finalization of floor maps, appliances, consumables, gadgets etc for centers (new and renovations) with approval from corporate office. 2. To train and groom the next identified successor as Centre Head ( staff identified from within the Centre team ) 3. In addition to the above mentioned duties and job functions, to carry out any other assignment given occasionally by the Regional Operations Head. While the above encapsulates all their responsibilities, the following needs a special mention and should be done on priority basis . To ensure cleanliness, hygiene and maintenance of the center. Regular reports on problems observed, actions to be taken and deadlines for the same. Special focus on service delivery, customer care, satisfaction, delight and feedback. Cash checking – To ensure systematic cash handling and maintenance of cash register . Physical cash and entries in the cash register should match. Report to be sent on any variation to all concerned.Role & responsibilities

title: R&D Packaging Development
description:
Role Objective: The design, development, and regulatory compliance of robust primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging solutions for Solid Orals, Ophthalmics, Injectables, and Drug-Device Combination Products across USV sites and CDMOs. This role ensures seamless launch execution, cost optimization, vendor qualification, and full compliance with global regulatory standards (ISO/USP) 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Design & Innovation: Design and develop primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging solutions for Solid Orals, Ophthalmics, Injectables, and Drug-Device Combination Products (including Pen Injectors and Autoinjectors). Introduce new packaging concepts, technologies, and continuous improvements for new or existing product categories. 
 Regulatory Compliance & Technical Documentation: Prepare and review technical documentation for regulated markets, including Threshold Analysis Reports, Design History Files , Device Master Records , Device History Records , and Medical Device Reporting (MDR) for 510(k) submissions. Prepare technical responses for regulatory queries and briefing packages. 
 Process Optimization & Commercial Execution: Prepare and review Specifications, STPs, MPCs, BOMs, and BPRs for submission and commercial launch batches at USV sites and CDMO/CMO facilities. Oversee packaging activities for submission/launch batches, evaluate packaging line machinery compatibility, lead blister change-part development, conduct equipment trials (FAT/SAT), and optimize line processes. 
 Value Engineering & Risk Management: Identify, evaluate, and implement continuous cost-optimization and value-engineering projects across packaging formats. Lead Risk Management activities, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and Human Factors Equivalency studies. 
 Testing & Characterization: Execute functionality and physical performance testing for solid oral packaging and drug-device combinations. Perform Reference Listed Drug (RLD) / Innovator packaging characterization, trade dress development, and reverse engineering. 
 Vendor & Systems Management: Lead packaging material and device supplier development and vendor qualification activities. Maintain hands-on operational management using SAP and TrackWise systems. 
 STAKEHOLDER INTERACTION Type of Interaction: Internal Interaction with: Cross-Functional Teams (CFTs) including R&D, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Production, Supply Chain, and Commercial Operations across USV sites Nature of Interaction: Technical review, project tracking, regulatory query response compilation, packaging line trials, and seamless transfer of packaging technologies to production. 
 Type of Interaction: External Interaction with: Contract Development / Manufacturing Organizations (CDMO/CMO counterparts), packaging material suppliers, device vendors, and equipment manufacturers. Nature of Interaction: Vendor qualification, equipment trials (FAT/SAT), technical discussions on change-parts, component sourcing, value engineering initiatives, and batch execution tracking. 
 JOB REQUIREMENTS Professional Experience and Relevant Skills Experience: 8 to 10 years of post-qualification experience in Pharmaceutical & Medical Device Packaging Development. 
 Technical Expertise: Deep technical expertise in solid orals, injectables, ophthalmics, and drug-device combination products (Pen Injectors/Autoinjectors). Thorough knowledge of global packaging standards (ISO 11608, ISO 11040, ISO 13485, ISO 14971) Hands-on knowledge of blister & bottle packing machines, change-part development, FAT/SAT equipment trials, and line optimization. Proficiency in generating DHF, DMR, DHR, FMEA, and 510(k) submission documentation. Hands-on working knowledge of SAP and TrackWise tools. 
 Skills: Strong cross-functional collaboration, project management, technical writing, problem-solving, and vendor negotiation skills. 
 Academic Qualifications & Certifications: Educational Qualification: Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in Packaging Technology from the Indian Institute of Packaging (IIP) or SIES Institute of Packaging.

 Position Overview The Lead Preservation Engineer is responsible for planning, implementing, monitoring, and controlling all preservation activities for HVDC offshore substation equipme nt from manufacture through storage, transport, installation, pre-commissioning, and handover . The role ensures equipment integrity, reliability, and warranty compliance in harsh offshore and marine environments. 
 Qualifications & Experience Bachelors degree in mechanical, Electrical, or Marine Engineering. 10+ years of experience in preservation, maintenance, or commissioning of HV or HVDC projects. Proven experience in offshore substations, marine facilities, or oil & gas projects. Strong knowledge of corrosion protection , marine environments, and long-term equipment storage. Familiarity with OEMs for HVDC systems (e.g., transformers, GIS, valves). 
 Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the Project Preservation Strategy and Preservation Management Plan. Lead preservation activities for HVDC equipment including transformers, GIS, valves, reactors, control panels, cables, and auxiliary systems. Define preservation requirements for long-term storage, offshore exposure, and marine transportation. Coordinate preservation activities across offshore platforms, fabrication yards, storage areas, and installation sites. Ensure compliance with OEM preservation manuals , project specifications, and contract requirements. Establish preservation checklists, inspection routines, and monitoring frequencies. Manage application of desiccants, nitrogen blanketing, heaters, coatings, wrapping, and corrosion protection systems. Review and approve preservation records, logs, and inspection reports. Identify preservation risks and implement corrective/preventive actions. Interface with Construction, QA/QC, Commissioning, Logistics, and HSE teams. Support technical queries, NCR resolutions, and warranty-related matters. Lead and mentor preservation engineers, inspectors, and technicians. 
 Offshore & HSE Responsibilities Ensure preservation activities comply with offshore safety regulations and marine standards. Participate in risk assessments, toolbox talks, and method statement reviews. Ensure safe handling and environmentally compliant use of preservatives, oils, chemicals, and coatings. Coordinate with offshore operations to minimize exposure-related degradation. 
 Documentation & Reporting Prepare and maintain preservation procedures, method statements, and work instructions. Maintain preservation status registers and KPI dashboards. Provide regular preservation status reports to project management and clients. Support final turnover dossiers and as-built preservation records. 
 Skills & Competencies Strong understanding of preservation standards and best practices. Leadership and coordination skills across multidisciplinary teams. High attention to detail and documentation accuracy. Ability to work in offshore rotations and challenging environments. Strong communication skills with clients, vendors, and contractors. 
 Standards & References IEC, ISO, and project-specific specifications. OEM Preservation Manuals and Warranty Conditions. Offshore and marine standards for corrosion and equipment protection.

A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures. Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability. System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems. Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference. Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers. Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution. System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability. Required Skills & Experience: Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes. Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams. Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security. Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation. Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred. Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required. title: Senior Manager - PR & Communications
description:
Job Summary We are seeking a visionary and highly strategic Senior Manager PR & Communications to lead our communication narrative and head the PR team. In this pivotal role, you will be entirely responsible for driving the global and domestic PR, media relations, and communication strategies for our three core pillars: our established fashion export house , our own homegrown fashion lifestyle brand , and our dedicated CSR initiative . Reporting directly to the MD, you will act as the brand custodian, managing a team to elevate brand equity, cultivate high-level media relationships, and seamlessly blend commercial fashion marketing with impactful CSR storytelling. 
 Core Responsibilities Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute comprehensive, long-term PR and communication strategies across the fashion export division, to ensure cohesive brand positioning. Team Management: Lead, mentor, and evaluate a dynamic team of PR, marketing, and community executives, ensuring high-quality execution of day-to-day operations and alignment with company goals. Direct Stakeholder Reporting: Partner closely with the Managing Director to align communication goals with overall business objectives, providing regular strategic updates and performance insights. Media & Influencer Relations: Cultivate and leverage top-tier networks with national and international fashion editors, journalists, critics, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and high-profile influencers. 360 Event Oversight: Oversee the conceptualization and high-level execution of major events, including international/national fashion shows, brand launches, pop-ups, and CSR exhibitions. Reputation & Crisis Management: Act as the primary gatekeeper for corporate communications, ensuring proactive risk mitigation and managing any sensitive media or public relations scenarios. Narrative & Content Direction: Approve and refine high-impact content including press releases, corporate speeches, brand manifestos, and digital editorial directions. Budget & ROI Tracking: Manage the annual PR and communications budget, optimizing resource allocation and analyzing key performance metrics to demonstrate tangible ROI to the leadership team. Required Skills and Abilities Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to turn complex business objectives into creative, narrative-driven PR campaigns across distinct B2B (export) and B2C (retail/CSR) segments. Leadership Excellence: Strong track record of leading, inspiring, and managing cross-functional creative teams. Industry Network: Deep, existing relationships within the luxury fashion, lifestyle, sustainability, and arts media sectors. Exceptional Communication: Flawless written, verbal, and presentation skills, with a sharp eye for luxury design aesthetics and visual storytelling. Agility & Multitasking: Ability to seamlessly switch gears between corporate export narratives, contemporary lifestyle branding, and grassroots artisanal CSR storytelling. Values Alignment: A genuine passion for Indian heritage crafts, sustainable fashion, and ethical community empowerment. 
 Qualifications & Experience Education: Masters or Bachelors degree in Public Relations, Mass Communication, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field. Experience: Minimum 7–9 years of progressive experience in PR and Communications, with at least 2–3 years in a managerial or team-leading capacity within the luxury fashion, lifestyle, or premium retail industries. Experience handling both commercial brands and NGO/CSR initiatives is highly preferred.

Key Skills: Brand Management,PR Management,Event Management,Corporate Communication,Social Media Management,Content Creation,Media Relations,analytics and reporting

The incumbent will work out of our India office on the US shift, collaborating closely with onshore client stakeholders and cross-functional teams. 
 Key Responsibilities : 
 AR Operations & Collections Management Oversee end-to-end AR follow-up for assigned client accounts across multiple payers including Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and Managed Care. Monitor and manage key AR metrics ,AR Days, Collection Rate, First Pass Resolution Rate, Denial Rate, and Ageing Bucket distribution. Drive timely resolution of outstanding claims, ensuring collections targets and SLA benchmarks are met consistently. Implement and oversee denial management workflows, root cause analysis, and corrective action plans. Manage work queues, prioritise high-value/ageing claims, and ensure zero revenue leakage. Team Leadership & Performance Management Lead, mentor, and manage a team of AR Analysts, Team Leads, and Associates (team size: 50-100 FTE's). Define daily/weekly targets, conduct performance reviews, and implement productivity improvement plans. Identify training gaps and coordinate with the L&D team for skill enhancement and cross-training programs. Foster a high-performance, accountability-driven team culture aligned with client expectations. Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary point of escalation for AR-related client queries and issues. Participate in weekly/monthly client review calls, presenting performance dashboards, trend analysis, and action plans. Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with US-based client stakeholders and onshore counterparts. Manage client escalations professionally, ensuring prompt resolution and communication. Process Improvement & Compliance Identify process gaps and drive initiatives to optimise AR workflows, reduce denial rates, and accelerate cash flow. Ensure adherence to HIPAA regulations, client-specific compliance policies, and internal quality standards. Collaborate with IT and technology teams on system enhancements, automation, and reporting improvements. Develop and document SOPs, process guides, and best practices for the AR function. Reporting & Analytics Prepare and present comprehensive AR performance reports daily, weekly, and monthly to senior leadership. Analyse payer behaviour, reimbursement trends, and denial patterns to drive strategic decision-making. Maintain dashboards and data integrity across practice management and billing systems. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field. 10-15 years of progressive experience in US Healthcare AR / Revenue Cycle Management in a BPO / KPO setup. Minimum 3-5 years in a managerial or senior leadership role managing large AR teams. In-depth knowledge of the US healthcare billing lifecycle charge entry, claim submission, denial management, payment posting, and collections. Strong working knowledge of payer-specific rules across Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and Managed Care plans. Proficiency in practice management / billing systems such as CMD, AMD, eCW or similar platforms. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, dashboards) and reporting tools. Demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding AR and collections targets in a high-volume BPO environment. Willingness and ability to work full-time from the office on the US shift (night shift, EST/CST hours). Communication & Interpersonal Skills Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills mandatory for daily interaction with US based clients and stakeholders. Ability to present complex data and operational insights clearly and confidently to senior leadership and client teams. Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills for managing payer disputes and client escalations. Effective cross-functional communicator with the ability to collaborate seamlessly across operations, quality, IT, and HR teams. Executive presence with professional email etiquette and formal business communication skills. Preferred / Good to Have Certification in Healthcare Revenue Cycle (CRCR, CHFP, or equivalent) is highly desirable. Experience with automation tools for AR workflows is a strong advantage. Exposure to multi-speciality or hospital billing environments. Six Sigma / Lean process improvement certification. Prior experience handling transition or on boarding of new AR client accounts. Work Mode Work from Office 5 days a week (mandatory). No hybrid/remote option. Candidates must be comfortable working night shifts from the office on a permanent basis. Flexibility to extend hours during month-end, quarter-end, or client escalation periods is expected.

title: Key Accounts Manager - B2B
description:
Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with lifes essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well. This position is in our Food Enterprise where we are committed to serving food manufacturers, food service customers, and retailers with a complete range of innovative ingredients and branded products. 

 Job Purpose and Impact 
 The Key Accounts Manager will help build and maintain effective long term relationships while maintaining a high level of satisfaction to an assigned group of customer accounts, with general supervision. In this role, you will help to identify and contact prospective customers, establishing relationships to generate sales and repeat business and assessing customer needs to suggesting appropriate products, services and solutions. 

 Key Accountabilities 
 With general guidance, identify, develop, propose, negotiate and close new sales. Build demand for products and services by raising their profile with customers. Achieve revenue targets by increasing purchases per account. Develop deep understanding of business, financials, products and services and the market or needs and challenges of assigned accounts and provides input into the development of detailed sales plans to monitor, assess and ensure sales goals are achieved. Conduct regular status and strategy meetings with customers to understand their needs and link them to the organization''s product and service strategies. Independently solve moderately complex issues with minimal supervision, while escalating more complex issues to appropriate staff. Other duties as assigned 

 Qualifications 
 Minimum Qualifications Bachelor''s degree in a related field or equivalent experience Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience, preferably in a B2B food ingredients background Other minimum qualifications may apply Preferred Qualifications Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills Commercial acumen with the ability to understand business priorities and drive outcomes Excellent influencing and negotiation skills

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About the Role: " We are looking for a highly analytical, collaborative, and results-driven Supply Chain Planning & Strategic Operations to lead our end-to-end supply chain transformation. This role sits at the intersection of global demand-supply balancing, strategic sourcing, and digital supply chain innovation. The ideal candidate will manage cross-functional Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), optimize multi-million dollar direct material/CAPEX spend portfolios, and orchestrate agile distribution networks (DRP) to ensure exceptional service levels. You will act as a core business driver leveraging advanced predictive analytics, enterprise platforms, and lean frameworks to eliminate structural inefficiencies." 
 Key Responsibilities: Integrated Business Planning & S&OP: Lead consensus Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and demand forecasting cycles across multi-plant environments to align commercial forecasts with plant capacities. Inventory Optimization: Monitor and improve key performance indicators including Case Fill Rate (CFR), On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery, and Days of Cover (DOC). Manage safety stocks and Slow-Moving/Obsolete (SLOB) inventory liquidation frameworks. Strategic Sourcing & Category Operations: Oversee an annual direct material and CAPEX sourcing spend portfolio valued up to USD 50M-60M. Lead contract negotiations, Annual Rate Contracts (ARCs), and Maintenance Commitments (AMCs) with global suppliers (Americas, APAC, EMEA). Network Logistics & DRP: Refine node-level Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) configurations, focusing on Full Truck Load (FTL) thresholds, mode-mix optimization, and shipment consolidation. Digital Transformation: Act as the business system owner/SPOC for advanced planning software and business intelligence implementation. Build and scale data-driven Power BI or Tableau dashboards to automate reporting. Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement across the department by anchoring 5S audits, Kaizen loops, Lean Six Sigma workflows, and strict quality compliance. 
 Desired Candidate Profile: Education: Bachelors degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or Computer Science). A Masters degree (MBA/PGDM) specializing in Operations, Supply Chain Management, or Project Management is highly preferred. Experience: 8–12 years of core experience in manufacturing, FMCG, retail supply networks, aerospace, or automotive/heavy engineering sectors. ERP & Sourcing Stack (Mandatory proficiency in one or more): ERP modules: SAP MM, SAP PP, SAP SD, SAP ECC, or SAP Hana. Sourcing/Planning Suites: SAP Ariba, o9 Planning Suite, SAP APO, Palantir Foundry, OMP Planning Software, or Infor M3. Analytics: Advanced MS Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or QlikView. 
 Certifications (Preferred): Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, IATF 16949 / ISO Quality Auditor, or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) credential. Key Competencies: High analytical acumen, strong negotiation and cross-functional communication skills, and data-driven problem-solving mindset.

Job Description General Manager Purchase Position- General Manager Purchase Location - Nariman Point, Mumbai Industry- Plastic Injection Molding / Automotive / Engineering Plastics Maximum CTC- 30 Lakhs per Annum Experience - 15–20+ Years 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven General Manager – Purchase with strong expertise in Plastic Injection Molding and Plastic Raw Materials . 
 The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing the organisation’s procurement and sourcing strategy, managing strategic suppliers, driving cost optimisation, developing new vendors, supporting localisation initiatives, and managing both domestic and international sourcing/imports . 
 The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of engineering plastics, commodity plastics, additives, masterbatches and other raw materials used in plastic injection molding , along with excellent negotiation and supplier management capabilities. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Strategic Sourcing Develop and implement strategic sourcing strategies for plastic raw materials, components and indirect materials. Identify and evaluate new domestic and international suppliers. Drive supplier consolidation and category management initiatives. Develop long-term sourcing strategies aligned with business requirements. Monitor commodity and raw-material price movements and market trends. 
 2. Plastic Raw Material Procurement 
 Strong understanding of PP, ABS, PC, PA, POM, PBT, PMMA, HDPE, LDPE, Nylon, TPE/TPU and engineering polymers . Knowledge of recycled and virgin plastic materials and their commercial implications. Evaluate material specifications, grades, applications and alternate sources. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, MOQ, lead times and commercial agreements. 
 3. Imports & International Sourcing 
 Manage sourcing and procurement from international suppliers. Strong understanding of import procurement processes, documentation, logistics and landed-cost calculations. Develop overseas supplier networks for plastics and related materials. Evaluate international suppliers based on quality, cost, capacity and delivery performance. Work closely with logistics and finance teams to optimise import costs. 
 4. Costing & Cost Optimisation 
 Develop and validate product and raw-material costing. Analyse should-cost, conversion cost, material cost and landed cost . Drive annual cost-reduction initiatives. Identify alternate materials, suppliers and processes to improve margins. Conduct price benchmarking and market intelligence. Negotiate annual rate contracts and long-term commercial agreements. 
 5. Localisation 
 Develop and execute localisation strategies for imported materials/components. Identify capable Indian suppliers for localisation opportunities. Conduct commercial and capability assessments of potential suppliers. Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Production teams for localisation trials. Reduce dependency on imports while maintaining quality and cost competitiveness. 
 6. Supplier Development & Vendor Development 
 Identify, qualify and develop new suppliers. Build a strong and reliable supplier base for critical materials. Monitor supplier performance in terms of Quality, Cost, Delivery and Service . Conduct supplier evaluations, audits and performance reviews. Work with suppliers to improve capacity, quality and delivery performance. Develop alternate sources for critical materials to minimise supply-chain risks. 
 7. Purchase Operations 
 Lead the complete procurement function and ensure uninterrupted availability of materials. Establish appropriate inventory and procurement strategies. Develop annual procurement budgets and monitor procurement spend. Ensure timely release and closure of purchase orders. Establish and monitor procurement KPIs. 
 8. Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Work closely with Production, Quality, R&D, Engineering, Finance, Stores and Logistics . Support new product development through early supplier involvement. Participate in supplier selection and commercial evaluation for new projects. Ensure procurement decisions support production, quality and profitability objectives.

 Strategic Sourcing Plastic Raw Material Procurement Plastic Injection Molding Industry Experience International Sourcing & Imports Localisation Costing & Cost Reduction Supplier Development Vendor Development Price Negotiation Commodity & Market Analysis Supplier Evaluation Contract & Commercial Management Procurement Planning Inventory Management Team Leadership 
 Educational Qualification 
 BE/B.Tech/Diploma in Mechanical, Polymer, Plastics, Production, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline. MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Procurement or Operations will be an added advantage. 
 Preferred Industry Background 
 Candidates from the following industries are preferred: 
 Plastic Injection Molding Automotive Plastics Engineering Plastics Polymer / Plastic Processing Automotive Components Polymer Compounding Plastic Raw Materials Consumer Durables Industrial Plastics 
 Ideal Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate should be a strategic procurement leader who combines strong technical knowledge of plastics with excellent commercial and negotiation skills.

 Managing significant procurement spends. Developing domestic and international suppliers. Driving localisation of imported materials/components. Achieving measurable cost savings. title: Warehouse Executive-gold and diamond
description:
Job Description PMC / Warehouse Executive Role Purpose To ensure effective coordination and control of materials, inventory, karigaar workflow and related operational processes within Z-Studio, enabling smooth prototype development, material availability, traceability and timely movement of materials and products. The role will act as a key coordination point for material planning, inventory control, documentation, karigaar-related processes and operational discipline , with a strong focus on accuracy and accountability. Key Responsibilities 1. Material & Inventory Management Manage day-to-day inventory of materials and stock associated with Z-Studio activities. Ensure systematic recording and tracking of material receipts, issues, transfers and returns. Maintain material accountability and support regular reconciliation of physical and recorded stock. Ensure appropriate control and custody of valuable materials and secure storage areas. 2. Material Planning & Procurement Coordination Identify material requirements based on prototype and product development needs. Coordinate ordering of diamonds and other materials required for Z-Studio prototypes. Monitor material requirements and availability to support timely execution of work. Manage ordering and replenishment of workshop consumables and stationery as required. 3. Karigaar & Workflow Coordination Maintain relevant records of karigaar allocation, material issues, work status and material returns. Track movement of work and materials to support smooth workflow and timely completion. Ensure appropriate documentation and accountability throughout the karigar workflow. 4. BOM & Process Data Management Maintain and update relevant BOM and material-related data. Ensure alignment between approved requirements, material issued and material consumed wherever applicable. Maintain accurate operational records required for tracking and reconciliation. 5. In-warding & Dispatch Control Coordinate the in-warding of materials and ensure appropriate documentation and recording. Manage material/product dispatches with proper records and traceability. Ensure movement of materials and products follows defined processes and controls. 6. Audit & Control Conduct periodic physical stock checks and surprise audits as required. Identify discrepancies, gaps or exceptions and ensure appropriate follow-up and closure. Maintain records related to material accountability, karigar transactions and stock movements. Support effective control over valuable materials, including safe/key management. 7. Dust & Recovery Material Management Ensure systematic collection and recording of production dust and recovery material. Coordinate secure handling and dispatch of collected dust as per the defined process. Maintain appropriate records for traceability and accountability. Additional Responsibilities The role may be assigned additional responsibilities, processes or operational objectives from time to time , based on evolving business requirements, Z-Studio operations and organizational priorities. The above responsibilities are therefore indicative and not exhaustive , and the incumbent is expected to support related activities necessary for effective functioning of the operation.

Nirmal Industrial Controls Pvt Ltd Thane , Maharashtra, India (On-site) 
 Exciting Opportunity at Nirmal Industrial Controls Pvt. Ltd ! 
 About the Company: - 
 Established in 1973, Nirmal Industrial Controls Pvt Ltd., is Pioneer & leader of global repute, in the Field of Self Actuated Pressure Control valves, Safety Relief Valves, Gas Conditioning Pressure Regulating and Metering Skids delivering cutting-edge solutions to diverse industrial sectors like Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Refineries, Pharmaceutical, Steel, Power, Food & Dairy, Plastic, and Nuclear Power. Company has Global foot print with joint Acquisition of Repco Milan (An EPC company with a rich legacy in Gas Dehydration Units & Gas Treatment Plants) and Oiltech Italy (A Process Engineering House), International sales network in Middle East, Africa, Europe and Americas. 
 Website : https://www.nirmal.co.in 
 About the Role : 
 We are looking for a highly motivated and execution-focused professional to join the Directors Office as an Executive Assistant. This role serves as a trusted partner to the Managing Director, supporting strategic initiatives, driving cross-functional projects, and ensuring effective execution of key business priorities. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is comfortable working with senior leadership across multiple business functions. Skills & Competencies : 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Proven project management and execution skills. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration. High ownership, accountability, and attention to detail. Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives in a dynamic environment. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to BI tools is an added advantage. High level of integrity, professionalism, and discretion while handling confidential information. 
 Roles & responsibilities : Partner closely with the Managing Director to drive strategic initiatives and organizational priorities. Lead cross-functional projects focused on business transformation, operational excellence, process improvements, and digital initiatives. Prepare executive presentations, business reviews, dashboards, reports, and meeting materials for leadership discussions. Develop project plans, define milestones, monitor progress, and ensure timely execution of key initiatives. Track organizational goals, action items, and strategic priorities while driving accountability across teams. Coordinate with business and functional leaders to facilitate seamless communication, collaboration, and execution. Build and maintain management dashboards that provide visibility into business performance, KPIs, and project status. Conduct research, data analysis, and business assessments to support strategic decision-making. Identify opportunities for process improvements and recommend practical, scalable solutions. Support the MD in managing high-priority assignments, ensuring timely follow-up and closure. 
 Click on below link to apply : 
 https://careers.nirmal.co.in/jobs/Careers

 As a  Python Developer (Analyst)  within our team, you will contribute to the development and support of full-stack applications and data-enabled services. You'll work on building FastAPI back-end services, React-based front ends, Databricks jobs/notebooks for data processing, and integrations with SharePoint for document/workflow enablement. Build and enhance  React.js  front-end components and pages with a focus on usability, performance, and maintainability. Create and productionize data workflows in  Databricks  (notebooks, jobs, workflows), including transforming and validating data. Design and implement data models and persistence using  SQLite  (schemas, queries, indexing basics, migrations as needed). Build and support integrations with  SharePoint  (e.g., document storage, metadata, lists/workflows) aligned to business needs. Write clean, testable code; contribute to unit/integration tests, code reviews, and automated quality checks. Assist with environment setup, deployments, and operational readiness (logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, runbooks). Partner with stakeholders to clarify requirements, estimate work, and deliver iteratively with strong ownership and attention to detail. Maintain clear technical documentation for APIs, workflows, and support procedures. 
 Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills: 3+ years  of software development experience (or equivalent project/internship experience with strong hands-on delivery). Strong  Python  skills, including API development experience with  FastAPI  (or similar REST frameworks). Experience building UI features with  React.js  and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development practices. Working knowledge of  Databricks  and Spark-based data processing concepts (ETL/ELT, transformations, job execution). Proficiency with  SQL  and relational data concepts; experience with  SQLite  or similar relational databases. Familiarity with integrating enterprise platforms such as  SharePoint  (files/lists/metadata; APIs or connectors). Understanding of software engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), testing, debugging, and secure coding practices. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams. 
 Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills: Experience with API best practices (OpenAPI/Swagger, validation, authentication/authorization patterns, pagination, error handling).  We are looking for a skilled and motivated Structural Engineer to join our engineering team in Mumbai. The successful candidate will be responsible for structural analysis, design, and preparation of engineering deliverables for a range of building and infrastructure projects.

Develop and review structural framing schemes and structural details. Carry out analysis using relevant structural engineering software. Assist in preparing design concepts, calculations, specifications, and technical submissions. Review contractor/shop drawings and respond to technical queries and RFIs. Participate in design coordination meetings and provide technical input as required. Identify and resolve structural design and coordination issues. Master's degree in Structural Engineering will be an advantage. 6-9 years of relevant experience in structural design and consultancy. Strong knowledge of RCC and steel design . Good understanding of structural analysis principles and design methodologies. Familiarity with relevant Indian Standards (IS Codes) and international codes where applicable. Experience with structural analysis/design software such as ETABS, SAFE, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000 , or equivalent. Good working knowledge of AutoCAD ; Revit Structure/BIM experience is an advantage. Ability to read and interpret architectural and structural drawings. Strong coordination and communication skills. Ability to work independently as well as part of a multidisciplinary team. 
 Preferred Skills Experience working on residential, commercial, hospitality, high-rise, or mixed-use projects . Experience in a multidisciplinary engineering consultancy environment. Knowledge of BIM and coordinated design workflows. Experience in reviewing drawings and technical submissions. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. title: Physiotherapist
description:
Junior Physiotherapist 
 Position Overview We are looking for a motivated, responsible, and patient-focused Junior Physiotherapist to join our clinical team. The candidate will work under the guidance of senior physiotherapists and contribute to assessment, treatment, rehabilitation, patient education, documentation, and overall clinic operations. Key Responsibilities Conduct basic physiotherapy assessments under senior supervision. Assist in developing and implementing individualized treatment and rehabilitation plans. Provide treatment for orthopaedic, neurological, sports injury, post-operative, geriatric, and other rehabilitation patients as per clinical requirements. Perform therapeutic exercises, strengthening, stretching, mobility, balance, posture, and functional training. Assist with manual therapy and electrotherapy modalities as per the treatment plan. Monitor patient progress and modify exercises/treatment as instructed by the senior physiotherapist. Educate patients regarding home exercises, posture, ergonomics, precautions, and lifestyle modifications. Ensure patients perform exercises safely and with correct technique. Maintain accurate and timely patient records, treatment notes, progress reports, and follow-up documentation. Conduct regular patient follow-ups and encourage treatment and exercise compliance. Communicate professionally with patients, attendants, doctors, and other healthcare professionals. Maintain cleanliness, organization, and proper functioning of the treatment and exercise areas. Ensure physiotherapy equipment and treatment areas are used safely and responsibly. Assist in clinic camps, assessments, awareness programs, and patient education activities when required. Support senior physiotherapists in day-to-day clinical and administrative activities. Maintain patient confidentiality and follow professional and ethical standards. Represent the clinic professionally and contribute to a positive patient experience. Home Physiotherapy Visits The candidate should be willing and comfortable to undertake home physiotherapy visits when required. Home visits may include assessment, treatment, therapeutic exercise, rehabilitation, mobility training, and patient/caregiver education. The physiotherapist is expected to maintain the same level of professionalism, clinical standards, documentation, and patient care during home visits as in the clinic. Home visits may be scheduled based on patient requirements and clinic availability. Home visits will be compensated separately from the regular salary through a percentage-based incentive/revenue-sharing structure. The applicable percentage for each home visit will be discussed and mutually agreed upon at the time of joining. Home-visit incentives will be calculated based on completed/eligible visits as per the clinic's applicable policy. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 1. Patient Care & Treatment Quality Safe and effective patient handling. Correct execution of prescribed treatment protocols. Quality of exercise instruction and progression. Improvement in patient functional outcomes. 2. Patient Compliance & Retention Patient adherence to treatment plans and home exercise programs. Follow-up and appointment compliance. Patient communication and satisfaction. Ability to build professional and positive patient relationships. 3. Clinical Documentation Accurate assessment and treatment records. Timely updating of patient progress notes. Proper documentation of home visits and treatment outcomes. 4. Clinical Skill Development Continuous improvement in physiotherapy assessment and treatment skills. Ability to understand and implement appropriate rehabilitation protocols. Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society.  About the Role 
 We are looking for a skilled and motivated Structural Engineer to join our engineering team in Mumbai. The successful candidate will be responsible for structural analysis, design, and preparation of engineering deliverables for a range of building and infrastructure projects.

Experience with structural analysis/design software such as ETABS, SAFE, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000 , or equivalent. Good working knowledge of AutoCAD ; Revit Structure/BIM experience is an advantage. Ability to read and interpret architectural and structural drawings. Strong coordination and communication skills. Ability to work independently as well as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Knowledge of BIM and coordinated design workflows. Experience in reviewing drawings and technical submissions. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. title: Video Editor
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW As our Video Editor, you will own end-to-end post-production across brand, campaign, product, and social content. The role requires strong editing craft, visual storytelling, and motion design, with the ability to use AI tools strategically to extend creative possibilities and improve production workflows. You should be equally comfortable shaping a narrative in the edit, building branded motion graphics, and integrating AI-generated assets into a polished final film. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Edit and produce polished short-form and long-form video content for social media, paid campaigns, product videos, explainers, brand films, interviews, and internal communications. Own the post-production process including footage selection, pacing, transitions, colour correction and grading, sound design, subtitles, versioning, and final delivery. Create high-quality motion graphics including kinetic typography, title sequences, lower thirds, logo animations, infographics, UI animations, explainers, transitions, and branded motion systems. Use Adobe After Effects for 2D animation, compositing, masking, tracking, rotoscoping, visual effects, and other motion-led treatments where required. Use AI tools for concept development, image and video generation, image-to-video workflows, clean-up, upscaling, voiceover, localisation, and other production enhancements. Integrate AI-generated footage and assets seamlessly into traditional edits while maintaining consistency in style, lighting, movement, quality, and brand identity. Collaborate with marketing, content, and design teams to translate briefs, scripts, and storyboards into clear, engaging video narratives. Optimise content for Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, websites, ads, and other platforms with the correct aspect ratios, captions, durations, codecs, and export settings. Maintain organised project files, reusable templates, and video assets while delivering multiple projects on time in a fast-paced creative environment.REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 7+ years of professional experience in video editing, motion graphics, post-production, or a closely related creative role. A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating video editing, motion graphics, visual storytelling, and AI-assisted or AI-generated video work. Software proficiency: strong working knowledge of industry-standard editing and motion-design software. Adobe Premiere Pro | Adobe After Effects | DaVinci Resolve | Final Cut Pro Strong editing fundamentals with a sharp sense of storytelling, pacing, music, rhythm, transitions, composition, and audience retention. Strong motion graphics skills with a solid understanding of typography, animation principles, keyframing, compositing, and visual hierarchy. Hands-on experience with AI video and creative-generation tools such as Runway, Sora, Kling AI, Pika, HeyGen, Synthesia, or similar platforms. Good technical knowledge of video formats, codecs, frame rates, resolutions, colour workflows, sound, export settings, and project-file management. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with AI image-generation tools such as Midjourney, DALL•E, or Stable Diffusion for creating assets, style frames, and visual references. Working knowledge of Blender or Cinema 4D for integrating basic 3D elements into motion-design projects. Strong prompt-writing skills and experience combining multiple AI tools into practical creative workflows. Experience creating reusable motion templates, MOGRTs, Lottie animations, or modular branded animation systems. Basic knowledge of production automation or batch workflows using tools such as FFmpeg or Python. Prior experience in a startup, agency, fintech, technology, or fast-paced brand environment

title: O2C Collections Assistant Manager
description:
Position Title: O2C Collections Assistant Manager Reports To : O2C Collections Senior Manager Position Location: Goregaon East Shift Timing: 5:30 PM-2:30 AM IST 
 Job Purpose - 
 The Assistant Manager is responsible for working closely with clients, Operations and Segment Finance on problem resolution and debt management, while ensuring customer satisfaction. 
 
The successful candidate will primarily reduce delinquencies by calling on delinquent accounts, monitoring accounts and reviewing assigned accounts to resolve discrepancies using North Americas credit and collections processes, tools, standards and capabilities. The candidate will liaison with internal and external customers as required and will provide action-oriented performance analyses in an efficient and transparent manner. 
 
Provide day-to-day leadership and direction to a team of Executives & Senior Executives, ensuring portfolio performance, workload allocation, quality and service delivery are consistently achieved.
 
Translate collections strategy and targets into clear team priorities, monitor execution and intervene proactively on performance related concerns.
 
Working closely with team on complex customers, operational and people matters, resolving issues within agreed authority and escalating material risks appropriately. 
 
 Main assignments -Collections/Support Operations 
 Allocate and rebalance workloads across Executives & Senior Executives based on portfolio size, aging, risk, complexity and business priorities. Monitor daily/weekly team performance against agreed collections KPIs and SLAs, identify gaps and drive timely corrective actions. Review high-value, high-risk, aged and chronic delinquent accounts with the team and provide guidance on collection strategy, escalation and next actions. Coach Executives/Senior Executives on customer conversations, dispute resolution, PTP conversion, follow-up discipline and effective strategies. Ensure consistent adherence to collection processes, controls, documentation standards and escalation protocols. Lead performance reviews to communicate priorities, share insights and remove operational roadblocks. Support implementation of process improvements, automation and standardization initiatives within the collections team. Optimize diligent cash collection through efficient use of collection tools and generate worklist/account queue. Contact Accounts Payable of high value clients regarding past due balance. Understand their situation and work to resolve delinquency. Investigate and resolve client queries, discrepancies and disputes. Document collection activity and progress in each client profile, including appropriate coding, clear notes, promises to pay, and required follow-up dates and actions. Actively prioritize and organize work to ensure Service Level Agreement (SLA) objectives are realized Promote strong collaborative relationships between the FSS Credit & Collection Team, Operations, Segment Finance, and other stakeholders Request write-offs, reapplications and refunds appropriately 
 Portfolio Risk 
 Conduct regular portfolio reviews to identify emerging risks, aging deterioration, chronic disputes, broken PTPs and accounts requiring management intervention. Track and communicate key portfolio trends and exceptions to the Collections Manager / Sr. Manager and relevant stakeholders. 
 
 Person Specification - MBA Finance, Master of Commerce / Bachelor of Commerce 8+ years of experience in Shared Services with experience in O2C and Accounts Receivable Technically strong, with a working knowledge of Collections & Debt Management Commercial/business-to-business collections experience Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to interact effectively with all levels throughout Company organization ERP AR module user experience, preferably SAP Prior experience supervising or leading a team in accounts receivable, credit & collections, finance or a shared-services environment. Experience managing collections performance through KPIs such as cash realization, aging, overdue %, DSO, PTP adherence, dispute resolution and productivity. Experience handling escalations and complex customer/account issues with demonstrated ability to drive resolution. 
 
 Competencies Demonstrated people-management capability, including coaching, feedback, performance management and employee development. Ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in a dynamic operating environment. Strong analytical and decision-making capability, with the ability to translate performance trends into actionable improvements. Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Operations, Segment Finance, customers and senior management. Ability to motivate and engage a team while maintaining accountability for performance and service delivery. Ability to identify root causes of performance gaps and implement practical corrective actions. Working knowledge of continuous improvement, process standardization and change management principles. Ability to successfully collect past due invoices while enhancing the customer relationship/experience and ensuring timely payment to accelerate AR collections and deliver solutions. Maintain a strong customer-service focus by managing detailed account discussions professionally and preserving constructive customer relationships. Ability to de-escalate conflicts over the phone. Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to drive issues to resolution. Ability to work cross-functionally to resolve issues and bring them to resolution timely to receive payments Exceptional time management and organizational skills Ability to multitask and prioritize workload. High degree of initiative and ability to work well independently; and in a collaborative team environment with a demonstrated customer service orientation.
